title: render
description: A render job for Unreal's Movie Render Queue, driven by film-ue render / the render.job op. Frames are the sequence's display-rate frame numbers, end exclusive; sizes in pixels; times in seconds; memory in GB.

name.description: job name: the report, the manifest and videos are named after it (default: the sequence's asset name)

level.description: map package path, /Game/... (default: the level open in the editor)

out_dir.description: directory on the render box for frames, report and videos

preset.description: starting point for every setting below (default final)

frames.description: [start, end) in sequence frames (default: the playback range)

shots.description: only these camera cuts: camera labels, or 0-based cut indices (default all)

spatial.description: spatial samples per temporal sample (anti-aliasing; path tracer: samples per pixel)

temporal.description: temporal samples per frame (motion blur sub-steps)

warmup_render.description: frames rendered and discarded at each shot start (temporal history)

warmup_engine.description: frames the engine ticks without rendering at a chunk start when it has no pre-roll

preroll.description: cut (default): a chunk that starts after its camera cut's first frame is pre-rolled from that first frame (the sequence evaluated frame by frame, nothing rendered) so cloth and physics arrive in the state a full-shot render would have

aa_method.description: override the project's anti-aliasing (default: the project's)

shutter_timing.description: where a frame's temporal samples (motion blur) sit: center (MRQ's default, N-s/2..N+s/2), open (N..N+s) or close; open keeps a camera cut or a stepped key on frame N out of the frame before it (a centred shutter blends the previous shot's camera into a shot's first frame)

path_tracer.description: render with the path tracer instead of deferred (Lumen)

quality.description: apply the film-quality cvars (Lumen, VSM SMRT, hair MSAA, DOF, blur)

cvars.description: console variables while rendering (on top of the preset's), name: number

passes.description: render passes / AOVs (default [beauty]); more than one writes <out_dir>/<pass>/

items.description: One output. png/jpg/exr/bmp/wav are written by Movie Render Queue; h264/h265/prores are encoded with ffmpeg from the image frames (plus the WAV when there is one) after each render.

multilayer.description: exr: every pass in one multilayer file (default false)

alpha.description: png: write the alpha channel (default false)

crf.description: h264/h265: constant rate factor, 0 = lossless, 18 = visually lossless (default 18)

profile.description: prores: 0 proxy, 1 LT, 2 standard, 3 HQ, 4 4444, 5 4444 XQ (default 3)

audio.description: video: true (default) muxes the render's WAV, a path muxes that file, false = silent

audio_offset.description: video: seconds of audio to skip so it lines up with the first frame (default: the first frame's time in the sequence)

file.description: video: output file name in out_dir (default <name>.<ext>)

executor.description: pie (default): inside the editor; process: a separate -game process the editor starts and watches; cmdline: a manifest and command line for a process with no editor at all

save_dirty.description: process/cmdline: save unsaved packages first (default true; false makes unsaved packages an error)

chunking.description: shot (default): one MRQ job per camera cut; none: one job for the range; an integer: per cut, at most that many frames per job

resume.description: skip frames already on disk (default true)

overwrite.description: delete the frames in range first (default false)

file_name.description: MRQ file name format (default {frame_number}; {render_pass}/{frame_number} with several passes)

boxes.description: render boxes to plan for (default 1): chunks are balanced by estimated time

game_overrides.description: MRQ Game Overrides to set explicitly (absent = MRQ's own defaults, which every render already gets as a transient setting: cinematic scalability, LOD 0, no HLODs, cloth time-step smoothing off); give only what you want to change

texture_streaming.description: none: leave the project's; disabled: no streaming (most VRAM); fully_load: load used textures fully (less VRAM)

path_tracer_min_gb.description: refuse the path tracer below this total VRAM in GB (default 40)

abort_pct.description: cancel the render when VRAM use passes this percentage, before the driver kills the editor (default 97; 0 = off)

force.description: render even when a guard says no
